name.local: ジャパン・エナジー・ファンド

strategy.thesis: Climate-tech fund accelerating Japan's transition to a decarbonized society by investing in leading climate technology (battery tech, smart meters, offshore wind, virtual power plants, demand response) in US/European startups with potential to scale in Japan. Describes itself as the only fund from Japan purely focused on climate tech and US/Europe startups.

summary.en: Tokyo-based climate-tech venture fund founded in 2019 to accelerate Japan's decarbonization by backing leading US/European climate-tech startups (battery, offshore wind, VPP, demand response). Second fund targets US$50M, with $1-3M checks at Series B and beyond. LPs/partners include BIPROGY, ENECHANGE, Toshiba Energy Systems and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank.
summary.local: 2019年設立、日本の脱炭素化を加速するため、世界（特に米欧）の有力な気候テック・スタートアップに投資する東京拠点のクライメートテック・ファンド。2号ファンドは5,000万米ドルを目標とし、1社あたり100〜300万米ドルを投資。

strategy.thesis: Supports and invests in 'zebra companies' — businesses that pursue both social-issue resolution and sustainable profitability, rather than VC-style winner-take-all unicorn growth. Provides management support, direct equity and ecosystem-building; backed by SIIF.

summary.en: Tokyo firm founded March 2021 by experienced impact/startup investors to grow and support 'zebra companies' — firms balancing social impact with durable profitability that fall outside the unicorn-focused VC mainstream. Raised ¥100M in 2021 and invests directly (not as a fund); backed by SIIF.

strategy.thesis: Climate-change/environment-specialized fund from independent VC ANRI, backing seed-stage deep-tech startups in solar/wind, batteries, hydrogen/ammonia, CCUS/DAC, artificial photosynthesis and fusion. Extended fund life (up to 15 years) to suit capital-intensive, long-horizon climate technologies.

summary.en: ANRI GREEN No.1 is a climate-change/environment-specialized fund launched by independent VC ANRI in 2022, with a ¥4.3B first close (announced Jan 2022) targeting ¥10B. It invests mainly at seed in deep-tech (solar/wind, batteries, hydrogen/ammonia, CCUS/DAC, fusion) with an extended fund life suited to long-horizon climate tech. LPs include JIC, Kansai Electric's K4 Ventures and JAPEX.
summary.local: 独立系VCのANRIが2022年に設立した気候変動・環境問題特化型ファンド。総額43億円の一次募集を完了し、最終的に100億円規模を予定。シード期を中心に太陽光/風力、蓄電池、水素/アンモニア、CCUS/DAC、核融合などのディープテックに投資。

name.en: Japan Investment Corporation for Carbon Neutrality (JICN)
name.local: 株式会社脱炭素化支援機構

aum.raw: ¥20.4B initial capital (¥10.2B public industrial investment + ¥10.2B private)

strategy.thesis: Public-private decarbonization fund established under METI/Ministry of the Environment by converting the former Green Finance Organisation Japan into a joint-stock company. Supplies risk capital to a wide range of decarbonization projects — renewables, energy efficiency, hydrogen/ammonia, CCS/CCU, circular economy and green mobility.

summary.en: Public-private decarbonization fund established 28 Oct 2022 under Japan's Ministry of the Environment, reorganizing the former Green Finance Organisation Japan into a joint-stock company. Initial capital of ¥20.4B (¥10.2B state industrial investment + ¥10.2B private from 57 financial institutions and 25 companies) supplies risk money to decarbonization projects (renewables, hydrogen/ammonia, CCS/CCU, circular economy, green mobility). Early support included Zeroboard and WOTA.
summary.local: 2022年10月28日に環境省主導で設立された官民ファンド。前身のグリーンファイナンス推進機構を株式会社に改組。資本金204億円（国の産業投資102億円＋民間102億円）で、再エネ・水素/アンモニア・CCS/CCU・サーキュラーエコノミー・グリーンモビリティなど脱炭素事業にリスクマネーを供給。

Portfolio includes 280 Earth, KAICO and MentaRest.

name.local: ソーシャルXインパクトファンド

strategy.thesis: Japan's first impact investment fund using dormant bank deposits (休眠預金). Co-managed by Social X and QR Investment (Hokkoku Financial Holdings), it targets public-private co-creation solutions to local social issues — children/childcare, education, health/medical, welfare, disaster prevention, energy, agriculture/fisheries, tourism, transport and community.

summary.en: Japan's first impact investment fund financed by dormant bank deposits, established Feb 2025 with first close and targeting a ¥1.0B final close by end-2025. Co-managed by Social X and QR Investment (Hokkoku Financial Holdings), it makes ¥5M–¥50M seed/early-stage investments in startups solving local social issues via public-private co-creation (childcare, education, health, welfare, disaster, energy, agriculture, transport). Anchor LP is JANPIA.
summary.local: ソーシャル・エックスと北國フィナンシャルHDの投資子会社QRインベストメントが共同GPを務める、国内初の休眠預金を活用したインパクト投資ファンド。2025年2月組成、2025年12月末に10億円でのファイナルクローズを目指す。出資額は500〜5,000万円、シード〜アーリー期が対象。アンカーLPはJANPIA。

strategy.thesis: Kyoto-based social-investment firm (Type II Financial Instruments Business Operator) creating local-finance mechanisms: the 'en.try' hometown-support crowdfunding platform (investment/donation/purchase), social impact bonds, and operation of social impact funds such as the Ritsumeikan Social Impact Fund.

summary.en: Kyoto-based social-investment company (a Type II Financial Instruments Business Operator) building local capital-circulation mechanisms — the 'en.try' hometown-support crowdfunding platform, social impact bonds, and the operation of social impact funds including the Ritsumeikan Social Impact Fund. To date ~55 projects, 1,500 supporters and ¥18M+ raised on its platform.

strategy.thesis: 100%-Ritsumeikan-funded impact fund investing in social enterprises started (or to be started) by Ritsumeikan faculty, students and alumni. 'Grassroots innovation' policy linking investees with education/research; invests in for-profit and non-profit social ventures, including local-zebra companies. Operated by Plus Social Investment.

summary.en: Impact fund (est. FY2020) set up with 100% Ritsumeikan Academy capital, sized at ¥1.0B (reported ¥1.5B more recently), investing in social enterprises founded by Ritsumeikan faculty, students and alumni under a 'grassroots innovation' policy. Investments include ¥100M into refugee-employment social enterprise Robo Co-op (a non-profit's first such raise) and Hokkaido local-zebra firm Sakewo. Operated by Plus Social Investment.

Combines investment with fundraising support, impact management and community finance.

summary.en: Catalytic local-impact micro-fund established in 2025 in Asahikawa, Hokkaido by Takumi Kubo (b.1993; former disability-support welfare NPO worker and certified fundraiser). The Impact Cube Fund pursues a 'local × social' market — financing regional social-issue solutions (welfare, community) and building local capital circulation, paired with fundraising support and impact management.
summary.local: 福祉系NPO出身・認定ファンドレイザーの久保匠氏が2025年に北海道旭川市で設立した株式会社すくらむが組成した『インパクトキューブファンド』。ローカル×ソーシャルの市場を切り開く触媒的資金を提供し、地域課題解決（福祉・コミュニティ等）と地域の資金循環を目指す。

Established by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government with MUFG Bank, Mitsubishi Estate, Shionogi, Tokio Marine and MPower Partners; operated by GPs MPower and NEXTBLUE.

summary.en: Japan's first startup-support fund 100% dedicated to women's advancement, established March 2025 by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government with MUFG Bank, Mitsubishi Estate, Shionogi, Tokio Marine and MPower Partners. Targets up to ¥8.0B (the program envisions up to ¥13.0B across two GP vehicles, with ¥4.0B from Tokyo). It backs women founders and startups advancing women's participation; operated by GPs MPower (Kathy Matsui) and NEXTBLUE (Kanako Inoue).
